null_means: not established by the reviewed sources, not zero

coverage.note: The comparable annual series uses fiscal-year labels. Calendar-year and short campaign measurements are separate observations and are not converted into fiscal-year totals.

metric_definitions.source_reduction: Food waste prevented before disposal or redistribution.
metric_definitions.overproduction: Prepared food exceeding a defined consumption or service requirement; source definitions may vary.
metric_definitions.plate_waste: Food discarded after service to diners.
metric_definitions.pre_consumer_waste: Waste occurring before diners consume it; may include prep scraps and unserved food.
metric_definitions.anaerobic_diversion: Food scraps collected for energy/nutrient recovery; not food-waste prevention.
metric_definitions.donation: Edible surplus redistributed; not necessarily avoided production.
metric_definitions.tracked_production: Food production measured by a system, not food wasted or saved.
metric_definitions.tracked_consumption: Consumption quantity recorded or estimated by a system, not waste avoided.
metric_definitions.waste_per_swipe: Food-waste mass normalized by meal transactions; distinct from annual mass or unique diners.
metric_definitions.cost_savings: Monetary result; cannot be converted into kilograms without additional data.
